requests.name: blue_form
requests.prompt: Production animation sheet for Bullets of Fury, matching the approved attached sprite EXACTLY in design, material detail, sharp pixel clusters and palette. FRAME FORMAT: 320x320 pixels per frame, 32 frames in exactly FOUR columns and EIGHT rows, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Identical square cells, zero grid lines, zero labels, no scenery. Genuine transparent exterior. A fixed physical center at 160,160 of every cell. One constant camera and art scale throughout; changes in the effect's size must be newly drawn forming/collapsing anatomy, not scaled copies. All sparks and spikes safely inside each cell with clear margins. Full-open pose should occupy the same proportion of its cell as the supplied 320x320 reference; do not zoom or fit small early poses larger. Black interiors are opaque black, NOT transparent. Keep the mechanical-looking curved blue plasma blades, electric filaments and white hot north/south flares. Every pose is a distinct drawing, smooth chronological motion. Create the SEPARATE FORMING animation. Start with a tiny focused electric spark at the fixed center. Frames 1-4 spark wakes and branches; 5-12 four curved cobalt plasma tendrils unfurl and outline a partial circular aperture; 13-20 those rotating arcs connect, a dark central hole opens, and the outer plasma blade shape assembles; 21-28 the complete ring settles at the reference's final size with north/south flares; 29-32 settle into the EXACT supplied fully open pose. Frame32 must closely match the reference. Animate charge buildup and material formation, not a static portal scaled up. This is a one-shot opening, NOT a loop, so do not return to the small spark at the end.

requests.name: black_void_form
requests.prompt: EDIT THE SUPPLIED TALL SPRITE GRID. FRAME FORMAT: exactly 4 columns and 8 rows, 32 square cells on a 1:2 PORTRAIT transparent canvas, 320x320 per cell. All32 slots must exist; do not omit the last row. Every effect centered at exactly the same physical point as the reference in every slot; common art scale, generous transparent margins, stationary camera. No labels, numbers or gridlines. Native alpha outside, opaque black central aperture while open. The repeated seeds are a layout and style reference ONLY: replace them with thirty-two distinct chronological poses for the FORMING animation of this approved Bullets of Fury black-chromium biomechanical void: glossy black alien chrome ribs curl into four spiral arms around an opaque black central throat. Narrow silver edges, tiny emerald circuits, sparse violet arcs. Preserve this dark metallic material and the FOUR curled ribs, do not turn into a blue energy ring. One-shot forming: rows1-2 tiny centered electrical ignition becomes thin curved tendrils; rows3-4 the material unfolds and connects, opening a central black void; rows5-6 the aperture and material grow into the complete authored shape; rows7-8 the last arcs lock together and settle into EXACT reference form and size. The very last cell is a match to the supplied seed. Newly draw the unfolding material, not an image scaled up. Preserve detailed BOF arcade sprite rendering and palette. Animate around the registered center, never drift, wobble the camera or clip a cell.
